live.assetComparison: All five changed runtime and page assets match after Git newline normalization

handoff.limitations: One conditional model estimate, not unique physical inference. Fixed initially solar composition, nonrotating single-star grid, only four calibrated phase flags and complete atmosphere cells. Controls snap together; selected values are model predictions. Physical iPhone not tested.

latestRequirementReview.requirement: Light-derived diagnostics distinguish evolutionary stage, including oscillation period spacing
latestRequirementReview.finding: Version eight selects one nearest model and breaks ties by source order. This is not evidence of unique stage classification. No oscillation calibration is implemented.
latestRequirementReview.blocker: Validated oscillation-to-stage calibration and applicable coverage are absent from the current app dataset.

lightOnly.assumptions: Synthetic model explorer: fixed fiducial distance ten parsecs, zero extinction, bolometric flux, isotropic isolated single star. No mass, age, gravity or stage inputs.
